headline: DP.6 SPLIT VERDICT: per-class survival fails — 4 of 34 mixed classes have negative channel sums (each a single monomial, hence negative on ALL of s in (0,1): 1^8 2^11 3^4, 1^9 2^12 3^1, 1^10 2^11 3^2, 1^11 2^11 3^1) — but the GLOBAL sum is certified positive on all of (0,1); cross-class cancellation at each s-exponent restores positivity
